newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX ACCESS gasoline firms on lower stocks.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX ACCESS gasoline firms on lower stocks.

text.p: Unleaded gasoline futures edged up on NYMEX ACCESS trade Tueday, after U.S. gasoline stocks fell according to the American Petroleum Institute's weekly inventory report, traders said.
Gasoline stocks on hand at nationwide refineries fell 1.22 millinonbarrels to end the week at 196 million barrels, or 5.8 million barrels below year ago, API said.
"(Traders) think the gasoline number looks strong right now...They're gonna track the crude on gas," one trader said.
Prices could also gain support from the shutdown of several crude and product pipeline's on Canada's Interprovincial pipeline into the U.S., traders said.
"There's a couple indications that'll allow them to bring (prices) up," the trader said.
Some of the lines, shut over the weekend, began flowing at reduced rates Tuesday and will tighten inventories this week, traders said
Unleaded gasoline for May delivery was traded 61.45 cents gallon, up 0.28 cents from the settle as 15 lots traded in the front month and 62 overall.
In overnight trade, NYMEX May crude rose eight cents a barrel to trade $19.43. About 1,082 lots traded overall and 698 in the front month.
NYMEX May heating oil rose 0.26 cents from the market close of 52.89, with total volume at 86 lots, and 93 lots traded in May, traders said.
